corrections.translation: Saat menerima paket, bandingkan syarat itu dengan yang terlihat. Sudut luar yang terlindungi tidak membuktikan bagian dalam dibungkus terpisah. Bila instruksi tampak terlewat, tunjukkan persetujuan pesanan, layanan pilihan, dan foto bagian yang relevan. Tanpa bukti, jangan menuduh peristiwa tertentu menyebabkan kerusakan. Jelaskan hasil yang diminta dan kondisi yang diterima sebelum menanyakan langkah berikutnya.

corrections.source: A support message that isolates an unexplained amount
corrections.translation: Tanyakan tepat selisih yang belum terjelaskan

corrections.source: When a reply comes back, enter the provider's explanation beside the line it concerns. If the difference is a previously unseen quantity, correct the quantity column. If it is an already established charge, link it to the earlier entry rather than creating another. Once the detailed services, freight and credits reproduce the statement, your worksheet can serve two purposes: checking the present transaction and building a more realistic estimate for a future parcel with similar requirements.
corrections.translation: Tambahkan penjelasan penyedia di samping entri yang dimaksud. Jika jumlah unit baru diketahui, perbarui kolom jumlah; jika pembayaran ternyata sudah tercatat, tautkan ke entri lama. Setelah layanan, ongkir, dan pengembalian cocok dengan tagihan, tabel dapat dipakai untuk memeriksa transaksi sekarang dan memperkirakan paket lain dengan kebutuhan serupa.

corrections.source: Multiple choices on one marketplace listing can mean different units, quantities and prices. Build the estimate from confirmed options before applying delivery or discounts.
corrections.translation: Satu halaman penjual dapat menawarkan beberapa satuan, jumlah isi, dan harga. Hitung dari varian yang telah dipastikan lebih dahulu, baru perhitungkan ongkir serta diskon.

corrections.source: Make the seller's selling unit explicit
corrections.translation: Tuliskan satuan jual dengan jelas

corrections.source: Read each option before copying the lowest displayed price. A listing can offer a complete set, a single piece, a replacement part or more than one pack size. Save the seller's option text in its original language as well as your translation. If you are buying two shirts in one colour and another in a different size, give them separate lines. An entry saying only three shirts gives you no way to check which line changed when the seller confirms part of the order.
corrections.translation: Sebelum menyalin harga termurah, buka tiap pilihan. Bisa berupa set lengkap, satu potong, suku cadang, atau pak dengan isi berbeda. Simpan teks asli penjual dan terjemahannya. Jika membeli dua kaus dalam satu warna serta satu ukuran lain, pisahkan barisnya. Tulisan “tiga kaus” saja menyulitkan pemeriksaan bila hanya sebagian tersedia.

corrections.source: Build the merchandise subtotal first
corrections.translation: Hitung subtotal barang terlebih dahulu

corrections.source: For example, assume the selected medium shirt costs 72 yuan, the large costs 76 and the two-piece set costs 130. Selecting two medium shirts and one set costs 274 before delivery. Accidentally using the 72-yuan shirt price for the set gives 216. The 58-yuan difference comes from selecting the wrong unit, not from a hidden freight charge. Keeping pack type, option, unit price and quantity in separate columns makes the error visible.
corrections.translation: Dalam contoh, kaus M seharga 72 yuan, L seharga 76, dan set dua potong seharga 130. Dua kaus M ditambah satu set menjadi 274 sebelum ongkir. Jika set keliru diberi harga kaus 72, jumlahnya 216. Selisih 58 yuan berasal dari satuan jual yang salah, bukan dari ongkir tersembunyi. Pisahkan jenis pak, varian, harga per unit, dan jumlah.

corrections.source: Check minimums and tiers against the selected mix
corrections.translation: Periksa batas minimum dan tingkat harga untuk kombinasi pilihan

corrections.source: A seller may display several quantity tiers. Read whether quantities can be mixed across colours and whether the minimum is per style or total. For a hypothetical offer priced at 55 per piece for four or more, a basket of three may still use the lower-volume price. Count complete selling units. Two pairs in a two-pair pack can be one selling unit even though the warehouse receives four individual articles.
corrections.translation: Periksa apakah beberapa warna boleh digabung dan apakah minimum berlaku per model atau seluruh pesanan. Bila suatu penawaran memasang 55 per unit mulai empat, keranjang berisi tiga mungkin masih dikenai harga eceran. Hitung satuan jual utuh: satu pak berisi dua pasang dapat merupakan satu unit jual meskipun gudang menerima empat benda fisik.

corrections.source: Split a discount using the rule printed on the order
corrections.translation: Bagi diskon sesuai aturan pada pesanan

corrections.source: Look at the seller summary before allocating the saving. A promotion may apply only to certain items or may change when a unit is cancelled. Keep the eligibility conditions with the order. When you simply need to share a bill, state your allocation method separately from the seller's calculation. For example, proportional distribution among eligible items may be fair among friends but does not describe which refund the seller will approve later.
corrections.translation: Lihat ringkasan penjual sebelum membagi penghematan. Promosi bisa hanya berlaku untuk barang tertentu atau berubah jika satu unit dibatalkan. Simpan syaratnya. Jika tujuannya membagi tagihan antarteman, catat kesepakatan terpisah dari perhitungan toko. Pembagian proporsional untuk barang yang memenuhi syarat tidak membuktikan berapa refund yang akan disetujui.

corrections.source: Carry item identities into the warehouse
corrections.translation: Pertahankan identitas tiap barang sampai ke gudang

corrections.source: Give each line a stable name, such as navy shirt medium or blue set large. When two deliveries appear, match warehouse entries to those names and counts. Keep one cancelled line in the ledger as cancelled rather than reusing its identifier for another piece. Before submitting a parcel, compare the count of completed entries against what you paid for. A total that balances financially can still conceal a missing colour or an incomplete set.
corrections.translation: Beri nama tetap seperti kaus biru tua M atau set biru L. Bila dua kiriman tiba, cocokkan nama dan jumlah dengan catatan gudang. Pertahankan baris yang dibatalkan dengan statusnya alih-alih memakai nomornya untuk barang lain. Sebelum membuat paket, hitung barang selesai dan cocokkan dengan yang dibayar. Uang bisa cocok meski ada warna atau bagian set yang kurang.

corrections.source: Buying for three people from one option grid
corrections.translation: Tiga penerima memilih dari satu halaman varian

corrections.source: Imagine three friends choosing trousers from one listing. One selects the unlined version in size medium, another selects the lined version in medium and the third selects the unlined version in large. The listing title and seller number are identical on all three records. The information that distinguishes them lives in the option columns. Write one complete selection per line and name the recipient in your private sheet. If the seller option names are translated alike, keep the original wording and thumbnail beside the selections.
corrections.translation: Misalnya tiga teman memilih celana dari satu penawaran. Yang pertama mengambil model tanpa lapisan ukuran M, yang kedua model berlapis ukuran M, dan yang ketiga model tanpa lapisan ukuran L. Judul dan nomor toko sama, tetapi pilihan berbeda. Tulis satu kombinasi penuh per baris beserta nama penerima di catatan pribadi. Jika terjemahannya mirip, simpan nama asli dan gambar mini.

corrections.source: Suppose the confirmed unit prices are 80, 94 and 80 yuan and the order has one 9-yuan domestic charge. The merchandise total is 254 and the order total is 263. If the payment request shows 269, inspect its components before calling the extra six a service charge. The seller may have changed the price of one variant, added an explicit charge or applied a different quantity. Compare each option, quantity and line subtotal in order. A three-line purchase is small enough to reconcile without guessing which part changed.
corrections.translation: Andaikan harga yang dikonfirmasi 80, 94, dan 80 yuan, dengan ongkir domestik 9 yuan sekali. Barang berjumlah 254 dan total pesanan 263. Jika permintaan pembayaran 269, periksa komponennya sebelum menganggap selisih enam sebagai biaya layanan. Salah satu harga, biaya yang dinyatakan, atau jumlah unit bisa berubah. Periksa varian, jumlah, dan subtotal tiap baris.

corrections.source: Checking a multi-pack against single units
corrections.translation: Bandingkan multipak dengan pembelian satuan

corrections.source: Read the size and colour assortment on the pack. A five-pack may contain an assortment chosen by the seller rather than five duplicates of a selected colour. If only two pairs match the need, dividing by five is a misleading measure of value to that buyer. Before paying, write a sentence describing exactly what should arrive: five wearable pairs in size X, with the colours distributed as stated in option Y. This sentence becomes a usable warehouse count instead of a number with no physical meaning.
corrections.translation: Baca ukuran dan campuran warna dalam pak. Lima pasang mungkin merupakan pilihan warna penjual, bukan lima warna sesuai pesanan. Bila hanya dua pasang cocok untuk keperluan Anda, membagi harga dengan lima menyesatkan. Tulis perkiraan isi, misalnya “lima pasang ukuran X dengan distribusi warna sesuai opsi Y.” Gudang dapat menghitungnya menurut kebutuhan yang jelas.

corrections.source: Take the example of two medium shirts and a set. If the seller confirms only one medium shirt, the original 274 no longer describes the goods available. One shirt at 72 plus the set at 130 gives a merchandise total of 202. Check whether a quantity threshold, domestic delivery condition or discount has changed as well. A cancellation can affect more than the removed unit if the promotion depended on the original basket.
corrections.translation: Kembali ke dua kaus M dan satu set. Jika hanya satu kaus M tersedia, 274 bukan lagi harga barang yang bisa dipasok. Satu kaus 72 ditambah set 130 menghasilkan 202. Periksa kembali syarat diskon, ambang jumlah, dan ongkir domestik. Pembatalan bisa memengaruhi item lain jika promosi bergantung pada keranjang semula.

corrections.source: Identifying a quantity mistake before it travels
corrections.translation: Temukan salah jumlah sebelum paket diberangkatkan

corrections.source: A photograph of three unopened packets can confirm that three packets are present. It may not confirm the number of units inside each. For a set with different contents per package, ask for a view or label that distinguishes the package versions without damaging packaging the seller may require. For separate garment sizes, match each readable size tag to a line on the paid order, especially when two colours differ only slightly under warehouse lighting.
corrections.translation: Foto tiga bungkus tersegel membuktikan ada tiga bungkus, tetapi belum memperlihatkan jumlah isi tiap bungkus. Untuk beberapa versi set, minta gambar atau label yang membedakannya tanpa merusak kemasan yang diperlukan penjual. Untuk pakaian berbagai ukuran, cocokkan tiap label terbaca dengan baris pesanan, terutama jika warna tampak mirip di bawah lampu gudang.

corrections.source: Keeping product mathematics separate from outbound freight
corrections.translation: Pisahkan harga barang dari ongkir internasional

corrections.source: The price per usable item can be useful before purchase, but do not silently add a future international fee to each seller line and treat the result as confirmed. Once the goods arrive, a shared parcel may contain items from several purchases and use packing that was unknown earlier. Retain the confirmed seller costs and add a separate outbound comparison when measured figures become available. If you later allocate freight among recipients, document that policy separately.
corrections.translation: Harga per unit berguna sebelum membeli, tetapi jangan menambahkan perkiraan ongkir internasional ke tiap baris penjual lalu menganggapnya sudah pasti. Sesampainya di gudang, barang bisa digabung dengan pembelian lain dan dikemas berbeda. Pertahankan biaya penjual yang telah dikonfirmasi. Bandingkan ongkir secara terpisah setelah ada data ukur. Jika dibagi antarpenerima, tuliskan aturannya.

corrections.source: A complete record lets you answer three questions without recalculating from memory. Which version and quantity did the seller agree to supply? How much was actually collected or returned on the purchase? Which items are ready for international submission? A purchase line can be financially complete while one piece is still waiting for identification, so close each line only when its contents and its payment history are both clear.
corrections.translation: Catatan lengkap menunjukkan varian dan jumlah yang disepakati, jumlah uang yang dipungut atau dikembalikan, serta barang yang siap dikirim keluar negeri. Keuangan bisa sudah beres meski satu barang masih perlu dikenali. Tutup baris setelah isi dan riwayat pembayarannya sama-sama jelas.

corrections.source: A multi-shop shortlist can look like one cart, while costs and delivery events still originate with different sellers. Organize the purchase by shop first and the international shipment by parcel later.
corrections.translation: Daftar belanja lintas toko bisa tampak seperti satu keranjang, tetapi biaya dan kiriman domestik tetap berasal dari penjual masing-masing. Kelompokkan pembelian per toko lebih dahulu, lalu pengiriman internasional per paket.

corrections.source: Create a small register for each seller
corrections.translation: Buat catatan kecil untuk tiap penjual

corrections.source: Save the original listing, chosen option, quantity, product amount and domestic delivery shown for that particular purchase. Put discounts under the shop where they apply. Two listings sharing the same studio photo can still be offered by different sellers. Use the shop identity and the marketplace listing number to distinguish them, and give the lines names you will recognize even if the seller edits the title.
corrections.translation: Simpan penawaran asli, varian, jumlah, harga barang, dan ongkir domestik untuk pembelian tersebut. Tempatkan diskon pada toko yang memberikannya. Foto studio yang sama bisa digunakan dua toko. Bedakan melalui identitas toko dan nomor produk, lalu beri nama baris yang tetap mudah dikenali jika penjual mengubah judul.

corrections.source: Keep committed costs separate from intentions
corrections.translation: Bedakan pengeluaran pasti dari rencana

corrections.source: Suppose shop A has confirmed a 90-yuan jacket and 8 yuan delivery. Shop B still shows a 54-yuan scarf with domestic delivery unknown. Shop C has cancelled a 30-yuan accessory and its refund has not arrived. Show 98 as the confirmed purchase cost for A, 54 plus an unresolved amount as the estimate for B and 30 as a pending credit if it was actually paid. Adding everything into one definite subtotal would hide three different states.
corrections.translation: Toko A sudah menyetujui jaket 90 yuan dan ongkir 8. Toko B masih menawarkan syal 54 dengan ongkir belum diketahui. Toko C membatalkan aksesori 30 dan refund belum masuk. Catat 98 sebagai biaya pasti A, 54 ditambah ongkir belum pasti sebagai rencana B, dan 30 sebagai dana kembali tertunda jika memang sudah dibayar. Satu total pasti akan menyembunyikan ketiga status itu.

corrections.source: Track arrivals without changing the accounting basis
corrections.translation: Lacak kedatangan tanpa mengubah dasar pencatatan uang

corrections.source: The parcel that reaches the warehouse first may belong to the last shop you ordered from. An arrival changes what you can inspect or submit for shipping, but does not automatically create an additional seller charge. Record the domestic tracking reference against the purchase and the warehouse reference against the received unit. If two tracking numbers arrive for one seller order, confirm the contents of each before treating either shipment as complete.
corrections.translation: Paket yang pertama tiba tidak harus berasal dari toko pertama yang dipesan. Penerimaan mengubah apa yang bisa diperiksa atau dikirim, tetapi tidak otomatis menambah tagihan toko. Kaitkan nomor pelacakan domestik dengan pesanan dan referensi gudang dengan unit diterima. Jika satu toko mengirim dua paket, pastikan isi keduanya sebelum menandai lengkap.

corrections.source: Decide what waiting for the last item costs
corrections.translation: Tentukan konsekuensi menunggu barang terakhir

corrections.source: Write down the warehouse deadlines for the items already stored and the latest confirmed information for the missing piece. Compare a combined parcel when all items arrive with sending the ready items now. Do not assign an invented cost to waiting. If a storage charge or packing service could matter, check the current account information. If the item has a firm use date, represent that constraint separately from the freight comparison.
corrections.translation: Tulis tenggat penyimpanan barang yang sudah masuk dan informasi terbaru yang dikonfirmasi untuk barang tertunda. Bandingkan menunggu semuanya dengan mengirim barang siap sekarang. Jangan memberi harga rekaan pada waktu tunggu. Jika biaya penyimpanan atau pengemasan berpengaruh, cek informasi akun. Jika barang dibutuhkan pada tanggal tetap, cantumkan batas waktu itu terpisah dari ongkir.

corrections.source: Rebuild the final total from its records
corrections.translation: Bangun kembali jumlah akhir dari dokumen

corrections.source: Start with net merchandise across sellers. Add the domestic amounts actually charged once each, then add outbound parcel payments and any separately shown services. Subtract refunds only when you can match them to the correct purchase, currency and destination. A refund returned to an account balance may affect your usable balance differently from a credit to your original payment method. Keep both the economic cost and the payment history visible.
corrections.translation: Mulailah dari nilai bersih barang yang dipertahankan dari semua toko. Tambahkan tiap ongkir domestik yang benar-benar ditagihkan satu kali, lalu pembayaran paket keluar dan layanan yang dipungut terpisah. Kurangi pengembalian setelah dipastikan pembelian, mata uang, dan tujuan dananya. Refund ke saldo akun bisa mengubah dana yang dapat digunakan secara berbeda dari refund ke metode pembayaran awal. Simpan biaya bersih dan riwayat aliran uang.

corrections.source: A basket that changes while the first item is in storage
corrections.translation: Ketika keranjang berubah saat barang pertama sudah disimpan

corrections.source: Imagine you have chosen a coat from one shop, a scarf from another and two bags from a third. The coat is received first. The scarf seller confirms the original colour is unavailable, and the bag seller sends two domestic tracking numbers. On your sheet you now have one ready item, one unresolved purchase and two shipments linked to one purchase. Listing all four items as ready would result in a parcel plan the warehouse cannot yet fulfill.
corrections.translation: Misalnya sebuah mantel tiba duluan, penjual syal menyatakan warna awal habis, dan penjual dua tas memberi dua nomor pengiriman. Ada satu item siap, satu pembelian belum pasti, dan dua kiriman dari satu pesanan tas. Semua itu belum berarti empat item siap digabung. Buat rencana paket sesuai barang yang benar-benar tersedia.

corrections.source: Work out two possible shopping baskets. In the first, the scarf is cancelled and the coat and both bags are retained. In the second, you accept a different scarf and wait for its arrival. Show confirmed costs shared by both scenarios once and note the costs and risks that differ. The first option may change freight by removing an item; the second may change warehouse timing. Neither estimate is complete until you have the measurements and services for the parcel you actually intend to submit.
corrections.translation: Bandingkan dua skenario. Pertama, syal dibatalkan dan mantel serta kedua tas tetap dibeli. Kedua, Anda menerima warna syal pengganti dan menunggu. Tampilkan biaya pasti yang sama satu kali. Skenario pertama bisa mengubah ongkir karena satu item dihapus; yang kedua mengubah waktu simpan. Keduanya masih bergantung pada dimensi dan layanan untuk paket sebenarnya.

corrections.source: Deciding who owes what in a shared basket
corrections.translation: Menentukan bagian tiap orang dalam keranjang bersama

corrections.source: Suppose one friend buys from shop A only and another friend buys from shops B and C. Individual seller charges belong to the appropriate purchase first. The friends might then agree to divide the international shipping equally, by weight or according to another rule. Keep that private agreement separate from the charges the sellers or HubBuy applied. A buyer's contribution can change when the packing plan changes even if no seller has altered its own amount.
corrections.translation: Jika teman pertama membeli di A dan teman kedua membeli di B serta C, masukkan biaya tiap toko ke pesanan yang sesuai terlebih dahulu. Pengiriman internasional kemudian bisa dibagi rata, menurut berat, atau sesuai kesepakatan lain. Simpan kesepakatan itu terpisah dari biaya penjual dan HubBuy. Bagian seseorang bisa berubah ketika rencana kemasan berubah meskipun semua harga toko tetap.

corrections.source: For example, three purchases might have net totals of 106, 64 and 180 yuan. Their combined purchase cost is 350. If one purchase later gets a 20-yuan credit, the new cost is 330. Assign that credit to the purchase it belongs to before splitting anything else. Subtracting it from the international parcel total would make it harder to explain either the net seller cost or the eventual outbound charge. Show a pending credit separately until it actually appears.
corrections.translation: Contoh tiga pembelian bersih 106, 64, dan 180 yuan berjumlah 350. Jika satu pembelian menerima pengembalian 20 yuan, biaya bersih baru 330. Terapkan pengembalian ke pembelian asal sebelum membagi jumlahnya. Menguranginya dari ongkir internasional akan menyulitkan penjelasan biaya toko maupun ongkir. Selama belum masuk, tampilkan sebagai pengembalian tertunda.

corrections.source: Inventory matching across deliveries
corrections.translation: Cocokkan barang dari tiap pengiriman

corrections.source: Use a unique row identifier for each chosen option. A short name such as coat-A-small is enough in a personal worksheet if it also points to the underlying order reference. When an intake notification arrives, match the item to a row using the seller, domestic tracking and identifying details. If two similar bags came from different shops, a studio picture shared by both shops is weaker evidence than the corresponding delivery record.
corrections.translation: Beri tiap varian kode baris unik. Nama ringkas seperti coat-A-small sudah cukup jika menunjuk ke nomor pesanan. Saat ada pemberitahuan masuk gudang, periksa penjual, pelacakan domestik, dan ciri produk. Untuk dua tas yang mirip dari toko berbeda, foto studio bersama kurang meyakinkan daripada dokumen pengirimannya.

corrections.source: If a delivery appears without an obvious match, do not immediately reassign it to whichever row is still blank. Check how many pieces each seller was expected to send, the last known tracking events and any note about a split delivery. Contact support with the specific unresolved record and the candidate orders. A clear inquiry might say that two domestic numbers were expected from shop C, one has an identifiable bag in stock, and you need help matching the second number to its intake.
corrections.translation: Jika ada paket yang belum bisa dicocokkan, jangan langsung memindahkannya ke baris kosong. Periksa jumlah barang per penjual, pelacakan terakhir, dan catatan tentang pengiriman terpisah. Tanyakan dengan referensi spesifik: misalnya toko C diperkirakan memberi dua nomor; satu nomor sudah cocok dengan tas di gudang, nomor kedua perlu dicocokkan.

corrections.source: Planning the outbound comparison with unresolved costs
corrections.translation: Rencanakan pengiriman ketika satu biaya belum diketahui

corrections.source: You can still make a useful decision with one missing number. Assume the confirmed items total 250 yuan and the preferred basket has a hard merchandise budget of 300. There is 50 left for the unresolved item plus any remaining seller charges. If the item's selected price alone exceeds 50, you already know this plan will exceed that budget, even before international freight. If the selected item costs 40, the decision turns on the remaining conditions. The calculation identifies what you need to ask next.
corrections.translation: Satu angka yang hilang tidak selalu menghalangi keputusan. Jika barang yang sudah dikonfirmasi berjumlah 250 yuan, sedangkan batas anggaran barang 300, tersisa 50 untuk item terakhir dan biaya toko yang belum pasti. Jika harga itemnya sendiri melampaui 50, rencana sudah melebihi batas sebelum ongkir internasional. Jika harganya 40, keputusan bergantung pada biaya sisanya.

corrections.source: Closing the basket without losing its history
corrections.translation: Tutup keranjang tanpa menghapus riwayat

corrections.source: After delivery, keep a final list of which purchases ended up in which parcel. Some may be returned, sent later or accepted as replacements. If you sent the coat earlier and the two bags later, the original one-box estimate is useful historical information, not the final transport bill. Enter two outbound references and their confirmed amounts. Where an amount is in another currency, retain its original value and the actual converted payment entry.
corrections.translation: Setelah pengiriman, catat pembelian yang masuk ke tiap paket. Sebagian mungkin dikembalikan, dikirim belakangan, atau diganti. Jika mantel berangkat lebih dahulu dan tas menyusul, estimasi lama satu kotak bukan tagihan akhir. Simpan dua referensi keluar dan nominal pastinya. Jika mata uang berbeda, pertahankan nilai asal dan pembayaran yang telah dikonversi.

corrections.source: Finish by checking arithmetic in stages. Sum retained merchandise by shop. Add domestic delivery shown on the relevant purchases. Apply confirmed seller credits. Add final parcel payments and separately billed services only once. Reconcile any friend-to-friend allocation to the result. The resulting total can then be traced to records the people involved can inspect, including the reason the final basket differs from the first shortlist.
corrections.translation: Jumlahkan barang yang dipertahankan per toko, tambahkan ongkir domestik, terapkan pengembalian yang sudah masuk, lalu tambahkan pembayaran akhir paket dan layanan yang ditagih terpisah masing-masing satu kali. Cocokkan total bagian teman dengan hasilnya. Dengan begitu setiap selisih dari daftar awal dapat ditelusuri ke dokumen yang tersedia.

corrections.source: Decide what you are comparing
corrections.translation: Tentukan angka apa yang dibandingkan

corrections.source: Include payment fees exactly once
corrections.translation: Hitung biaya pembayaran tepat satu kali

corrections.source: Round at the point where payment rounds
corrections.translation: Bulatkan pada tahap yang sama dengan pembayaran

corrections.source: When a seller summary collects several lines into one payment, convert the original-currency subtotal for your comparison. Rounding every small item first can create a few cents of difference from converting the order once. For a reimbursement sheet you may still need per-person figures. State which line absorbs the rounding remainder so that the sum of the allocations matches the amount actually paid.
corrections.translation: Bila penjual menggabungkan beberapa item menjadi satu pembayaran, konversikan dulu subtotal asli untuk pembanding. Membulatkan per item bisa menghasilkan selisih beberapa sen dibandingkan mengonversi satu pesanan penuh. Untuk penggantian biaya antarteman, tetapkan baris mana yang menanggung sisa pembulatan supaya jumlah bagian cocok dengan uang yang dibayar.

corrections.source: Worked example with a fixed fee
corrections.translation: Contoh membandingkan biaya tetap

corrections.source: Take a fictional payment in which the base amount is 300 yuan and the comparison rate is 7.50 yuan per home-currency unit. The base conversion gives 40.00. One hypothetical payment method adds a fixed fee of 1.30 home units. Another has no fixed fee but quotes a conversion that results in 41.00. For this amount, the second method would cost 0.30 less, provided both figures are final and cover the same goods and services. The lower quoted exchange figure alone does not determine the result.
corrections.translation: Misalnya pembelian 300 yuan dengan kurs pembanding 7,50 yuan per unit mata uang Anda. Konversi dasar menghasilkan 40,00. Metode pertama menambahkan biaya tetap 1,30 unit. Metode kedua tanpa biaya tetap menghasilkan pembayaran 41,00 melalui kursnya. Untuk pembelian ini metode kedua lebih murah 0,30 jika keduanya final dan mencakup hal yang sama. Kurs yang terlihat lebih rendah belum tentu menghasilkan jumlah akhir lebih rendah.

corrections.source: Now change the purchase to 75 yuan using the same illustrative conditions. The first method gives 10.00 plus 1.30, while an equally sized percentage difference on the second method might have a very different effect in absolute terms. Recalculate instead of assuming the method that won on the first purchase also wins here. Fixed fees matter proportionally more on small payments. These invented numbers explain comparison mechanics only and make no claim about the methods, rates or fees offered to any HubBuy account.
corrections.translation: Ubah pembelian menjadi 75 yuan dengan asumsi sama. Metode pertama menghasilkan 10,00 ditambah 1,30. Selisih persentase kurs yang sama pada metode lain dapat berdampak berbeda dalam nominal. Hitung ulang: metode termurah sebelumnya belum tentu menang sekarang. Biaya tetap lebih terasa pada pembayaran kecil. Angka latihan ini tidak menyatakan tarif atau metode yang benar-benar tersedia di akun HubBuy.

corrections.source: Keep a consistent direction in a mixed-currency worksheet
corrections.translation: Pertahankan arah konversi pada tabel beberapa mata uang

corrections.source: A common mistake occurs when a friend pastes a displayed conversion into a column that ordinarily contains original yuan amounts. The sheet then converts an amount that has already been converted, creating an implausibly low total. Use clear column names and keep screenshots or payment references close to the corresponding row. If you cannot tell which currency a pasted number uses, leave it out of the combined total until you can identify its unit.
corrections.translation: Kesalahan yang sering terjadi adalah menempelkan nilai tampilan yang sudah dikonversi ke kolom berisi yuan asli. Rumus lalu mengonversi lagi dan totalnya tampak terlalu rendah. Gunakan judul kolom yang menyebut satuan dan simpan tangkapan layar atau referensi pembayaran pada baris terkait. Jika mata uang suatu angka tidak diketahui, jangan masukkan ke jumlah gabungan dahulu.

corrections.source: Compare estimates at the same point in the transaction
corrections.translation: Bandingkan pada tahap transaksi yang setara

corrections.source: A product card viewed in the morning and a payment statement issued days later are different observations. Changes in selected variant, quantity, discounts or payment method can alter the result before exchange rates are considered. Begin by reconstructing the original-currency merchandise subtotal. Add domestic shipping and any services the relevant screen includes. Only once both source subtotals describe the same purchase should you compare conversion rates.
corrections.translation: Kartu produk pagi ini dan mutasi kartu beberapa hari kemudian bukan pengamatan pada tahap yang sama. Varian, jumlah, diskon, dan metode bayar mungkin berubah sebelum kurs berpengaruh. Susun ulang subtotal barang dalam mata uang asal, lalu tambahkan ongkir domestik serta layanan yang tercakup pada layar itu. Bandingkan kurs setelah kedua subtotal menyatakan pembelian setara.

corrections.source: For a parcel, keep packed measurements and route consistent as well. If the first screenshot was a quick estimate for one jacket and the second a final all-in payment for a larger consolidated package, no exchange-rate calculation can make them a fair pair. Mark the physical change first. If useful, obtain a new estimate for the same parcel inputs in the current display currency and state its date. An old figure can explain the history even when it cannot answer the present comparison.
corrections.translation: Untuk paket, gunakan ukuran setelah dikemas dan rute yang sama. Perkiraan cepat untuk satu jaket tidak sebanding dengan pembayaran akhir paket gabungan yang lebih besar. Catat perubahan fisik dahulu. Jika perlu, ambil perkiraan baru dengan data paket yang sama dalam mata uang tampilan sekarang dan cantumkan tanggalnya. Angka lama tetap berguna sebagai riwayat.

corrections.source: What a refund can and cannot tell you
corrections.translation: Apa yang dapat disimpulkan dari pengembalian dana?

corrections.source: A refund statement may show the original currency even when your card posts a home-currency credit. Record the two values in their own columns, matched by reference where possible. A different home-currency credit from the original debit can reflect several factors. Check the amount refunded in the original currency, the payment destination, any stated fee and the dates of the transactions before attributing a difference to exchange.
corrections.translation: Pemberitahuan pengembalian bisa memakai mata uang sumber sementara kredit kartu muncul dalam mata uang Anda. Simpan keduanya di kolom terpisah dan cocokkan referensinya. Bila kredit berbeda dari debit awal, periksa jumlah yang dikembalikan dalam mata uang asal, tujuan pengembalian, biaya yang dinyatakan, dan tanggal sebelum menyimpulkan perubahan kurs sebagai penyebab.

corrections.source: Suppose a 150-yuan line was originally included within a larger payment. The later credit may refer to that one line only, not a proportion of every service on the initial order. Domestic delivery or optional work may have separate terms. Use the explicit refund breakdown or ask about the named purchase. Applying an old per-item estimate that included an allocated share of freight can create a supposed shortfall that the actual refund statement never promised to cover.
corrections.translation: Misalnya satu item 150 yuan awalnya dibayar bersama beberapa layanan lain. Pengembalian berikutnya mungkin hanya untuk item itu, bukan pembagian semua layanan. Ongkir domestik dan pekerjaan pilihan bisa punya syarat sendiri. Gunakan rincian refund atau tanyakan pembelian yang dimaksud. Estimasi per item yang dulu memuat bagian ongkir dapat menciptakan “kekurangan” yang sebenarnya tidak termasuk janji refund.

corrections.source: Use a range when today's decision precedes payment
corrections.translation: Pakai kisaran untuk keputusan sebelum pembayaran

corrections.source: Sometimes a buyer needs a planning figure before the exact transaction rate is known. Show a sensitivity range using clearly labelled hypothetical rates instead of presenting a single amount as guaranteed. For a 450-yuan amount, 7.50 yuan per home unit produces 60.00, while 7.20 produces 62.50, before any additional charges. That 2.50 spread identifies how much the assumption matters for this hypothetical budget. It does not predict the rate available at checkout.
corrections.translation: Untuk anggaran sebelum kurs transaksi diketahui, tampilkan kisaran berdasarkan kurs contoh. Pembelian 450 yuan setara dengan 60,00 jika kurs 7,50 yuan per unit, atau 62,50 bila 7,20, sebelum biaya tambahan. Rentang 2,50 menunjukkan dampak asumsi pada anggaran ini. Angka itu tidak meramalkan kurs yang akan muncul saat pembayaran.

corrections.source: A practical final check
corrections.translation: Pemeriksaan terakhir yang praktis

corrections.source: Before accepting a number from a screenshot, identify the currency code and whether the price covers one unit, the selected quantity or the entire parcel. Save any quoted conversion alongside the original amount. Someone reviewing the purchase later should be able to reproduce the converted value using those saved inputs, even after the currency selector displays a different rate.
corrections.translation: Sebelum memakai angka dari tangkapan layar, identifikasi kode mata uang dan cakupan harga: satu unit, seluruh jumlah pilihan, atau satu paket. Simpan konversi bersama nominal asal. Data yang ada seharusnya cukup untuk menghitung kembali nilai tersebut walau pemilih mata uang kini menunjukkan kurs yang berbeda.

corrections.source: A service can change the parcel twice: once through its own price and again through its effect on the finished box. Capture those effects separately before choosing how to pack.
corrections.translation: Layanan pengemasan dapat mengubah biaya melalui tarifnya sendiri dan melalui perubahan pada kotak jadi. Pisahkan kedua dampaknya sebelum memilih pengemasan.

corrections.source: Start with what needs protection
corrections.translation: Tentukan bagian yang perlu dilindungi

corrections.source: Decide which part of the purchase must arrive in a particular condition. The concern might be a thin handle, vulnerable corners or a retail box needed as a gift. A request for the cheapest packing leaves the warehouse guessing about your priorities. Identify the item and the feature that matters. If keeping a retail box affects your decision, ask before authorizing its removal, particularly while any exchange question remains open.
corrections.translation: Tentukan kondisi yang harus dipertahankan: gagang tipis, sudut rentan, atau kotak eceran yang ingin diberikan sebagai hadiah. Permintaan “kemasan termurah” tidak menjelaskan prioritas Anda. Sebutkan barang dan bagian penting. Jika kotak asli dibutuhkan, tanyakan sebelum mengizinkan pembuangan, terutama jika kemungkinan penukaran masih terbuka.

corrections.source: Define comparable packing options
corrections.translation: Tetapkan alternatif yang sebanding

corrections.source: Separate the two price effects
corrections.translation: Pisahkan dua sumber perubahan biaya

corrections.source: Look at packaging removal as a trade-off
corrections.translation: Pertimbangkan konsekuensi melepas kemasan

corrections.source: Removing an empty spacer can reduce volume without changing the protection needed. Removing a rigid box from an item that depends on it for shape is a different decision. Identify what will replace the original protection. Ask whether parts such as cards, straps, wrapping or detachable pieces will be retained. If your concern is size rather than weight, check the finished longest side instead of assuming that discarding a box always changes the available routes.
corrections.translation: Membuang pengganjal kosong dapat mengurangi volume tanpa mengurangi perlindungan penting. Melepas kotak kaku yang menjaga bentuk barang berbeda akibatnya. Tentukan pengganti perlindungan dan tanyakan apakah kartu, tali, pembungkus, serta komponen lepas tetap disimpan. Jika kebutuhan utama adalah batas ukuran, periksa sisi terpanjang setelah dikemas, bukan hanya ada atau tidaknya kotak asli.

corrections.source: Before accepting the packing result
corrections.translation: Sebelum menyetujui hasil pengemasan

corrections.source: Comparing two versions of a mixed parcel
corrections.translation: Bandingkan dua susunan untuk paket campuran

corrections.source: Suppose the live representative figures you write down for an illustrative exercise are 130 for freight and 4 for the basic packing in A, compared with 136 for freight and 11 for the more protective service in B. The totals are 134 and 147. The extra cost of B is 13, consisting of six more in freight and seven more in selected packing. If the 136 already includes the protective service, the calculation changes. The wording of the line matters as much as the numbers, which are fictional and do not describe HubBuy's price list.
corrections.translation: Sebagai latihan, A memiliki ongkir 130 dan pengemasan dasar 4, sementara B memiliki ongkir 136 dan layanan pelindung 11. Jumlahnya 134 dan 147. Tambahan 13 untuk B terdiri dari enam ongkir dan tujuh perlindungan. Bila 136 ternyata sudah mencakup perlindungan, perhitungannya berubah. Ini angka rekaan, bukan daftar tarif HubBuy.

corrections.source: Decide what information is worth obtaining
corrections.translation: Tentukan informasi yang perlu diminta

corrections.source: Before asking a warehouse to prepare two complete alternatives, identify which uncertainty drives your decision. If keeping a retail carton is essential, comparing a box-free arrangement wastes time. If a route has a maximum outer dimension, the useful question may be whether the existing carton fits once protection is added. If the estimator shows a result for only one product category, clarify route acceptance for all contents instead of treating cheap packing as the deciding factor.
corrections.translation: Sebelum meminta dua kali percobaan kemasan penuh, cari ketidakpastian yang menentukan pilihan. Jika wajib menjaga kotak eceran, membandingkan skenario tanpa kotak tidak membantu. Jika ada batas panjang, tanyakan apakah kotak dengan pelindung masih memenuhinya. Jika hasil hanya muncul untuk satu kategori, konfirmasi bahwa rute menerima semua isi sebelum memilih dari harga.

corrections.source: Ask about any service charge for a change or for obtaining additional measurements. Do not assume that an alternative packing arrangement can be trialled, reversed and photographed without cost. Record what the account actually offers. A sensible short message identifies the current parcel, the protection that must remain and the measurement you need. For example, a buyer could ask whether the shortest eligible box that retains the protective insert will stay below a stated route limit. A useful answer concerns that precise plan.
corrections.translation: Tanyakan biaya perubahan atau pengukuran tambahan. Jangan berasumsi percobaan, pembongkaran ulang, dan foto alternatif gratis. Lihat layanan nyata di akun. Dalam pesan, sebut paket, pelindung yang harus dipertahankan, dan ukuran yang diperlukan. Misalnya tanyakan apakah kotak terpendek yang tetap memuat sisipan pelindung dapat berada di bawah batas rute tersebut.

corrections.source: Recognize when cost per kilogram is the wrong measure
corrections.translation: Kapan biaya per kilogram kurang tepat?

corrections.source: Some buyers compare packing by dividing the invoice by the scale weight. A heavier but better protected version may appear cheaper per kilogram even though it costs more overall. Conversely, a lighter parcel with a larger outer box may cost more on a route that considers volume. Use the total charge for the parcel that actually fulfills your requirements. Keep a per-kilogram calculation only when it helps answer a secondary comparison.
corrections.translation: Membagi tagihan dengan berat timbangan bisa membuat versi berat yang lebih terlindungi tampak murah per kilogram walau totalnya lebih mahal. Sebaliknya, kotak luar besar berisi barang ringan bisa lebih mahal bila rute memperhitungkan volume. Gunakan biaya total untuk paket yang memenuhi kebutuhan Anda; biaya per kilogram berguna hanya untuk pertanyaan tambahan yang sesuai.

corrections.source: Consider a fictional box costing 150 at 2 kg and another costing 160 at 2.5 kg. Their apparent costs per kilogram are 75 and 64. The lower unit figure belongs to the more expensive parcel. It may still be the better choice if the extra protective materials serve a real need, but the numerical ratio alone cannot settle that. A buyer evaluating whether to add protection should instead look at the incremental ten, the change in dimensions and the value of preserving the required condition.
corrections.translation: Misalnya satu kotak 2 kg seharga 150 dan yang lain 2,5 kg seharga 160. Biaya per kilogram tampak 75 dan 64. Jadi angka per kilogram yang lebih rendah justru milik paket lebih mahal. Tambahan perlindungannya mungkin bermanfaat, tetapi nilailah selisih sepuluh, dimensi yang berubah, dan pentingnya menjaga kondisi barang.

corrections.source: Separate removable packaging from essential components
corrections.translation: Bedakan pembungkus yang boleh dilepas dan bagian penting

corrections.source: A cloth bag inside a box might be disposable packing, a dust cover included with the merchandise or a separately paid accessory. Specify which you mean before asking for removal. Where several items carry loose parts, list the pieces that must remain together. Save the original option description if the item's completeness or potential return depends on a particular pouch or box. If the identity of a component is unclear, request clarification before allowing disposal.
corrections.translation: Kantong kain dalam kotak bisa berupa pembungkus sekali pakai, kantong debu bawaan, atau aksesori yang dibayar terpisah. Jelaskan yang dimaksud sebelum meminta penghapusan. Daftarkan bagian lepas yang harus tetap bersama. Bila kelengkapan atau syarat pengembalian bergantung pada kantong atau kotak tertentu, simpan deskripsi varian. Minta konfirmasi sebelum mengizinkan benda yang belum dikenali untuk dibuang.

corrections.source: A useful packing record can be short. Write one line per item stating retain, remove or ask, followed by the physical object concerned. For example, retain the protective insert around the handle, remove the empty seller dispatch carton if permitted, and ask before discarding the outer retail box. This makes the instruction understandable even when two boxes have similar dimensions. It also helps you interpret a photograph of the contents before sealing.
corrections.translation: Catat satu instruksi per objek: pertahankan, buang, atau tanyakan dulu. Misalnya pertahankan sisipan pelindung pada gagang, buang karton pengiriman kosong penjual jika diizinkan, dan tanyakan sebelum membuang kotak eceran. Petunjuk itu tetap jelas meski kedua kotak hampir sama ukurannya, dan membantu membaca foto isi sebelum ditutup.

corrections.source: At receipt, preserve photographs of the box and its internal arrangement if you need to report a problem. Document the visible condition; a photograph cannot establish where along the journey an impact occurred. Link the parcel reference, requested protection and observed outcome. Keep financial reconciliation and a condition complaint distinct even when both arise from the same shipment. One concerns which services were paid for, while the other concerns the condition in which the goods arrived.
corrections.translation: Saat menerima paket bermasalah, ambil foto kotak dan susunan di dalamnya. Catat kondisi yang terlihat tanpa menebak kapan benturan terjadi. Hubungkan referensi paket, perlindungan yang diminta, dan hasilnya. Pisahkan rekonsiliasi biaya dari keluhan kondisi walau menyangkut kiriman sama: yang satu tentang apa yang dibayar, yang lain tentang keadaan saat diterima.
